descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

observations_ja: 実38,473部品、固定分母9,669・目標38,676との差-203で許容内。完成正面・斜めと実MP4 frame1/18/54/73/108/144を閲覧した。
実寸487.8x695.8x598.6mm、実部品数倍率3.979005。黄色の頭と胴、黒い目、橙色の嘴、翼と尾を実ブロックで表す。相対格子は細かいが、頭頂・胸・翼の段階や目と嘴の角張りが残り、最大部品数を最良の外観とは判定しない。
本体38,473部品・139型とは別に実1個の仮支持台がある。3倍案の0個や2倍案の3個とは異なり、この4倍案は支台なしではない。嘴の下にある支台を完成CGや動画から隠していない。
ducky-p400-aid-01はDUCKY-P400-016770を支持し、その実組立step16565より前に必要。支持高さは246.4mm。部品IDの末尾をstepと誤認しない。
frame73では本体0部品でも支台は準備物として残る。現物の保持力と安定性を確認する前に撤去せず、withdrawalも未検証。細長い支台の座屈や接地、印刷変形を公称寸法適合だけで合格としない。
1x1例外14個、長辺15.8mm以上38,459個。native保存・別展開再openの全38,473ID/type/color/pose/step、保存sceneの139型の実頂点・面、放射分解の絶対位置復帰と空から全数への動作が一致した。
デジタル比較用の全データが揃った状態であり、現物の嵌合・保持力・荷重・転倒・支台撤去や印刷の承認ではない。外観選択も保留する。
observations_en: Actual38,473 pieces against the fixed9,669 denominator and target38,676, difference-203 within tolerance. Front/three-quarter stills and actual MP4 frames1/18/54/73/108/144 were inspected.

Actual size487.8x695.8x598.6mm and piece-count ratio3.979005. Yellow head/body, black eyes, orange beak, wings and tail are actual bricks. A finer relative grid still has crown/chest/wing terraces and angular eye/beak details; the largest count is not judged to give the best appearance.

One actual temporary aid is separate from the38,473figure pieces/139types. This differs from the3xcase's zero and2xcase's three aids; the4xcase is not stand-free. The beak support is not hidden from assembled CG or movies.
Ducky-p400-aid-01 supports DUCKY-P400-016770 before its actual assembly step16565, at support Z246.4mm. The part-ID suffix is not the assembly step.

Frame73has zero figure pieces while the separate preparation aid remains. Removal is forbidden before physical retention/stability checks; withdrawal is unvalidated. Nominal dimensions do not establish slender-support buckling, ground contact or print-deformation performance.

There are14one-cell exceptions and38,459parts with a long side of at least15.8mm. Native saving and relocation match all38,473IDs/types/colors/poses/steps. The saved scene matches139native mesh types, absolute radial return and empty-to-full animation.
All digital comparison data are complete, not physical fit, retention, load, tipping, support-removal or printing approval. Visual selection remains pending.
